title: Reboot the Elevator
reference: repeat 7 { F2 } def F1 { if box_ahead { jump jump } else { if tile_is y { jump } else { forward } } } def F2 { while not wall_ahead { F1 if on_switch { activate } } turn_right }
hints: Every trick in the tower, on one spiral: crates, steps, switches and hatches.
F1 makes one move (hop a crate, jump on yellow, or forward). F2 walks a side with F1, flips switches, then turns right. Main repeats F2.
repeat 7 { F2 } def F1 { if box_ahead { jump jump } else { if tile_is y { jump } else { forward } } } def F2 { while not wall_ahead { F1 if on_switch { activate } } turn_right }

story.intro: VANTA: "The core runs this tower. Touch it and it all goes dark."
story.outro: PATCH: "VANTA's core is going down the shaft... and the elevator's back! Come on down. I want to meet you in person, LoopBot."
